{{Top|leg}}
The '''mind-touch''' technique used by [[Raynar Thul|UnuThul]] allowed him to contact many [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] at the same time. This call was based on the communication abilities of the various hives in the Colony and was enhanced by UnuThul's use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
